The Dead Sea's Lisan Strait joined the northern and southern basins until 1979, so it is drawn joined here as it was in the first century; Lake Huleh (Semechonitis) was drained in the 1950s and is restored to its historical extent. 中央山脊干道上的旧约名城。: A well-known Old Testament town on the central ridge road.
以利亚与寡妇的故事发生地，耶稣在拿撒勒讲道时引用。: Where Elijah met the widow — the story Jesus cited when he preached in Nazareth.

传统上以色列地的南界，「从但到别是巴」。: Traditionally the southern limit of the land: "from Dan to Beersheba".
低加波利中保存最完整的希腊化城市，距加利利海约 60 公里。: The best-preserved Hellenistic city of the Decapolis, about 60 km from the Sea of Galilee.
低加波利十城之一，建在俯瞰湖东岸的马鞍形山顶，高出湖面约 350 米，可能即「山: One of the ten cities, built on a saddle-shaped summit above the eastern shore, about 350 m over the water — plausibly the image behind "a city set on a hill".
低加波利名城，以希腊哲学与诗人闻名，辖地一度延伸至加利利海岸。: A leading Decapolis city, known for its Greek philosophers and poets, whose territory once reached the shore of the Sea of Galilee.
低加波利唯一位于约旦河西岸的城市，也是十城中最大的一座，扼守耶斯列河谷东口。: The only Decapolis city west of the Jordan, and the largest of the ten, holding the eastern mouth of the Jezreel valley.
低加波利最南的大城，旧约的亚扪人京城拉巴。: The southernmost great city of the Decapolis, the Ammonite capital Rabbah of the Old Testament.
先知阿摩司的家乡，犹大旷野的西缘。: Home of the prophet Amos, on the western edge of the Judaean wilderness.

加利利海水面约在海平面下 209 米，死海约在 −400 米上下。从耶利哥（−2: The Sea of Galilee sits about 209 m below sea level, the Dead Sea around −400 m. Going from Jericho (−258 m) up to Jerusalem (+754 m) means climbing a full kilometre in 27 — "going up to Jerusalem" is literal.
加利利西侧唯一的天然良港，属叙利亚行省。: The only natural harbour west of Galilee, belonging to the province of Syria.

叙利亚行省的大城，本图东北角。: The great city of the province of Syria, at the north-east corner of this map.

Turn the land over and the distances and climbs in the gospels start to mean something.

基利心山与以巴路山之间的隘口，雅各井在此。耶稣与撒马利亚妇人谈论「活水」与敬拜的: The pass between Mount Gerizim and Mount Ebal, where Jacob's well stands. Here Jesus spoke with a Samaritan woman about "living water" and about which mountain one should worship on.
外邦妇人的信心: The faith of a Gentile woman
安提帕于公元 20 年左右建成的新首府，献给提比留。福音书中耶稣从未进城。: Antipas's new capital, founded around AD 20 and dedicated to Tiberius. In the gospels Jesus never enters it.
安葬耶稣的公会议员约瑟来自此城。: The town Joseph came from — the council member who buried Jesus.
山脊上的小村，一世纪估计仅数百人。耶稣在此长大，后来在会堂宣读以赛亚书，却被乡人: A ridge-top village of perhaps a few hundred people in the first century. Jesus grew up here, later read from Isaiah in its synagogue, and was rejected by his own neighbours. The administrative city of Sepphoris lay only about 6 km away.
希律为纪念父亲安提帕特而建，扼守沿海干道。: Built by Herod in memory of his father Antipater, commanding the coastal highway.
希律大帝的人工锥形宫堡与陵墓，从伯利恒即可望见。: Herod the Great's artificial cone of a palace-fortress and his tomb, visible from Bethlehem.
希律大帝耗时十二年建成的人工深水港，罗马犹太行省的行政首府；本丢彼拉多常驻于此，: The artificial deep-water harbour Herod the Great spent twelve years building, and the administrative capital of Roman Judaea. Pontius Pilate was based here, and the inscription bearing his name was found on the site.
希律大帝重建并献给奥古斯都的城，故改称西巴斯特。: Rebuilt by Herod the Great and dedicated to Augustus, which is why it was renamed Sebaste.
希律安提帕早期的加利利首府，福音书未提及，却是拿撒勒最近的城市。: Herod Antipas's first capital in Galilee. The gospels never mention it, though it was the nearest city to Nazareth.
希律建于死海西岸孤崖上的要塞宫殿，台地高出湖岸约 450 米，海拔却只有 59: Herod's fortress-palace on an isolated cliff above the western shore of the Dead Sea. The plateau stands about 450 m over the shore, yet only 59 m above sea level.
弥赛亚之地首页: The Land of the Messiah — home
往返加利利途中: On the road to and from Galilee
成长之城: The town he grew up in
拉撒路复活后公会定意杀耶稣，他便退到旷野边的以法莲城。: After Lazarus was raised the council resolved to kill Jesus, and he withdrew to Ephraim on the edge of the wilderness.

推罗以北的姊妹港城，本图北界。: Tyre's sister port to the north, and the northern edge of this map.
摩利冈南坡的小村，俯瞰耶斯列平原。耶稣在城门口叫寡妇的独子复活。: A small village on the southern slope of the Hill of Moreh, looking out over the Jezreel plain. At its gate Jesus raised a widow's only son.
摩押高原边缘的古城。: An ancient town on the edge of the Moabite plateau.
摩西眺望应许之地的山头，正对耶利哥。: The height from which Moses looked over the promised land, directly opposite Jericho.
撒马利亚人的圣山，「我们的祖宗在这山上礼拜」。: The Samaritans' holy mountain: "our fathers worshipped on this mountain".
族长时代的古城，撒马利亚人圣山基利心山脚下。: An ancient city from the age of the patriarchs, at the foot of the Samaritan holy mountain Gerizim.
旧约非利士五城之一。: One of the five Philistine cities of the Old Testament.
最后一次上耶路撒冷: The last journey up to Jerusalem
本图最高峰，终年积雪，是约旦河的主要水源，也是登山变像的另一候选地点。: The highest summit on this map, snow-capped year round, the main source of the Jordan, and the other candidate for the transfiguration.
橄榄山东坡的村落，门徒在此牵来驴驹。: A village on the eastern slope of the Mount of Olives, where the disciples fetched the colt.
橄榄山东麓、距耶路撒冷「约有六里」的村庄。马大、马利亚与拉撒路的家，也是耶稣受难: A village at the eastern foot of the Mount of Olives, "about fifteen stadia" from Jerusalem. Home of Martha, Mary and Lazarus, and where Jesus spent each night of the passion week.
死海西北岸的隐居社群聚落，死海古卷的出土地。: The settlement of a withdrawn community on the north-west shore of the Dead Sea, where the Dead Sea Scrolls were found.
死海西岸的泉水绿洲，以椰枣与香膏著称。: A spring-fed oasis on the western shore of the Dead Sea, known for its dates and balsam.
沿海平原与山地之间的行政市镇。: An administrative town between the coastal plain and the hills.
湖西北岸的渔村与关税站，位于通往大马士革的干道旁。马太福音称之为耶稣「自己的城」: A fishing village and customs post on the north-west shore, beside the highway to Damascus. Matthew calls it Jesus's "own city", and most of the Galilean ministry ran out of it.
湖西岸的渔业与腌鱼重镇，抹大拉的马利亚由此得名。已发掘出一世纪会堂与码头。: The fishing and fish-salting town of the western shore, and the place Mary Magdalene was named for. A first-century synagogue and harbour have been excavated.
湖西岸约 5 公里长的肥沃冲积平原，约瑟夫盛赞其物产。耶稣渡湖后在此登岸医治众人: A fertile alluvial plain some 5 km long on the western shore, whose produce Josephus praised. Jesus landed here after crossing the lake and healed the crowds.
犹大山地分水岭上的圣殿之城，海拔约 750 米。逾越节期间人口可膨胀数倍。耶稣的: The temple city on the watershed of the Judaean hills, about 750 m above sea level. At Passover its population could swell several times over. The entry on a donkey, the cleansing of the temple, the last supper, the trials, the crucifixion and the resurrection all happen inside less than two square kilometres.
犹大山地最高的城，族长的埋葬地。: The highest town in the Judaean hills, and the burial place of the patriarchs.
犹太地传统的出海口。: Judaea's traditional outlet to the sea.
福音书抄本分别作格拉森、加大拉、格革森。库尔西是唯一有陡坡直入湖中的地点，符合猪: The manuscripts read Gerasenes, Gadarenes or Gergesenes. Kursi is the only spot where a steep slope runs straight into the lake, matching the description of the pigs rushing down the bank.
约旦河下游东岸的渡口地带。施洗约翰在此施洗，耶稣受洗后进入旷野受试探。: The ford country on the east bank of the lower Jordan. John baptised here, and after his baptism Jesus went into the wilderness to be tested.
约旦河入湖处东侧，属腓力分封地。彼得、安得烈与腓力的家乡；医治瞎子与喂饱五千的传: East of where the Jordan enters the lake, inside Philip's tetrarchy. Home of Peter, Andrew and Philip; both the healing of the blind man and the feeding of the five thousand are tied to it.
约旦河谷东侧的低加波利城。传统记载耶路撒冷教会在公元 66 年战争前迁往此地。: A Decapolis city on the east side of the Jordan valley. Tradition has the Jerusalem church withdrawing here before the war of AD 66.
约旦河谷的绿洲与冬宫之城，海拔低于海平面约 258 米。由此上耶路撒冷需在约 2: The oasis and winter-palace city of the Jordan valley, about 258 m below sea level. Going up to Jerusalem from here means climbing over a thousand metres in some 27 km.
约瑟夫记载施洗约翰被囚并处死于安提帕的这座死海东岸山堡。: Josephus records that John the Baptist was imprisoned and put to death in this hill fortress of Antipas east of the Dead Sea.
约翰福音记载施洗约翰在「靠近撒冷的哀嫩」施洗，理由是「那里水多」。确切位置至今未: John's gospel has the Baptist baptising "at Aenon near Salim, because there was much water there". The exact site is still unsettled.
约翰福音记载的第一个「记号」。今址有两处候选：Kafr Kanna（传统）与北方: The first "sign" in John's gospel. Two sites compete: Kafr Kanna, the traditional one, and Khirbet Qana to the north, which most archaeologists prefer.
耶斯列平原东端的圆顶孤山，后世传统认为是登山变像之处（另一说为黑门山）。: The rounded, isolated hill at the eastern end of the Jezreel plain. Later tradition placed the transfiguration here; the other candidate is Mount Hermon.
耶稣公开传道时，加利利与比利亚属希律安提帕，东北部属希律腓力，犹太、撒马利亚与以: During the public ministry, Galilee and Peraea belonged to Herod Antipas, the north-east to Herod Philip; Judaea, Samaria and Idumaea were governed directly by a Roman prefect, and the east was the self-governing Decapolis. Getting from Galilee to Jerusalem meant either crossing Samaria or going around east of the Jordan.

耶路撒冷以南约 8 公里的山城，大卫的本乡。马太与路加都将耶稣的降生置于此地。: A hill town about 8 km south of Jerusalem, David's own town. Matthew and Luke both place the nativity here.
腓尼基的港口城邦。耶稣退到推罗、西顿境内，一位叙利腓尼基妇人为女儿求告，成为福音: A Phoenician port city-state. Jesus withdrew into the region of Tyre and Sidon, where a Syrophoenician woman pleaded for her daughter — a sign of the gospel reaching beyond Israel.
自治的希腊化港城，希律大帝的家族与此地有关。: A self-governing Hellenistic port, connected with the family of Herod the Great.
自西向东依次是海岸平原（0–50 米）、中央山脊（加利利、撒马利亚、犹大山地，多: West to east: the coastal plain (0–50 m), the central ridge (the hills of Galilee, Samaria and Judaea, mostly 500–1,000 m), and the Jordan rift. The drops between them decided where the ancient roads could run.
若「加略人犹大」指地名，则他是十二门徒中唯一的犹太地人。: If "Judas Iscariot" is a place name, he was the only Judaean among the twelve.
路加记载距耶路撒冷「约二十五里」（约 11 公里）。抄本另有「一百六十斯他丢」的: Luke puts it "sixty stadia" (about 11 km) from Jerusalem. Some manuscripts read a hundred and sixty instead, and four or five sites are still in the running.
迦密山南麓的古港。: An ancient harbour at the southern foot of Mount Carmel.
迦百农以北的黑玄武岩村落。与伯赛大、迦百农同被列入「有祸了」的责备。: A black basalt village north of Capernaum, named with Bethsaida and Capernaum in the "woe to you" rebuke.
通往埃及与阿拉伯商道的门户。: The gateway to the trade routes into Egypt and Arabia.
隔汲沦谷与圣殿相望，比圣殿山高约 70 米。橄榄山讲论、客西马尼祷告皆在此。: Facing the temple across the Kidron valley, about 70 m higher than the temple mount. The Olivet discourse and the prayer in Gethsemane both belong here.

黑门山南麓的泉源之地，原为潘神圣所。在这座满是异教神龛的城外，彼得宣认耶稣是基督: A place of springs at the southern foot of Mount Hermon, originally a sanctuary of Pan. Outside this town full of pagan shrines Peter confessed Jesus as the Christ, and Jesus first foretold his suffering.
